paragraphs: At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 7:6, Rabbi Matanyah said, “I went up for business and heard Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Yishmael, sons of Yeshua,” etc. Perhaps some scribal error has crept in.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source’s “perhaps” applies to a possible scribal error in this quotation; the quoted sons and business journey are retained without a proposed correction.

The consulted Jerusalem Yevamot passage has Matanyah going up on business and hearing Yochanan and Yishmael, sons of Yeshua. Hyman’s possible scribal-error explanation remains a possibility, without changing the supplied names or establishing relationships beyond the wording of this witness.
